name: Home elevator installation
summary: Residential elevators priced from drive, stops, travel feet, hoistway, cab and add-ons like pits and feeders.

items.label: Stops (unit + through-floor cut)
items.source: 4 h per stop (suggestedDriveKit pneumatic) + 5.5 h cut per stop (suggestedHoistwayKit through-floor); 2 stops default

items.label: Travel height (rail + through-floor hoistway)
items.source: 0.35 h per travel ft (pneumatic) + 0.55 h and $95 per ft (through-floor); 12 ft default

items.label: Travel miles
items.source: 0.04 h and $3.40 per mile (suggestedExtraKit); 10 miles default

specialistModels: Compares four drive types and five hoistways side by side and adds pit, machine room, auto doors, battery lowering, feeder and permit packages.
